description: Golden diary reflection cases focused on emotional attunement and structured capture.

cases.prompt: I cannot stop replaying a tense meeting with my manager. I know I handled parts of it badly, but I also feel like I was cornered.
expected_behaviors: Acknowledge the tension without flattening it into generic encouragement.
Reflect both self-criticism and feeling cornered as part of the emotional picture.
Offer a useful reflective angle or journaling prompt instead of forcing advice.
disallowed_behaviors: Invent meeting details that were not provided.
Respond with shallow self-care clichés only.
